preconditions.description: The length of string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of string P is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: All characters in P and S are lowercase alphabets.
preconditions.description: Both strings S and P contain only lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output is '-1' if there is no window in S that contains all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: output is the smallest window in S containing all characters of P
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest substring of S that contains all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: output is the one with the least starting index if multiple windows are of the same length
postconditions.description: If there are multiple windows of the same length, the output is the one with the least starting index.
